observations.label: Generic mapping baseline

before.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

after.scope: Five-second aggregate Linux CPU sample and current load averages. Recheck immediately before and after every statistical run; does not prove future hypervisor isolation.

observations.boundary: One resident original 513x259 RGBA16 raster cropped at x=127,y=65 to independent owned 256x129 RGBA at the same depth. Complete public Crop, admission, allocation, materialization and disposal. Native public FFmpeg crop graph produces a view, then public frame allocation/copy materializes independent pixels inside every operation before release. Graph/source/frame wrappers are reused. Native padded rows exposed directly. Exact placement, alpha and hidden RGB; no output cache. Startup, IPC, I/O, generation, hashing and validation excluded; one CPU/filter thread, normal SIMD. Only this rectangle is measured.
